summary: Local macOS bounded test-only hybrid modal proposal comparison. QR recovers a nearly parallel-column analytic sample whose rounded Gram system is rejected; binary column scales, row orders, rank/range failures and factor reuse are checked. Local/global QR switching shares the existing four-step and 80-check budgets. Independent physical reassembly and constructed result JSON readback retain qualified unit/large-coordinate samples. QR, grid and amplitude proposals do not resolve the 128-element tiny-coordinate physical failure. This proves scoped comparison and recovery controls, not new runtime algorithm admission, public QR execution, general multimode, live Agent, installed/remote or performance qualification. Production algorithm selection and residual gates are unchanged.
